messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: high error-rate and model-mismatch detected for requests routed via smart-routing in eu-west-1. Symptoms: increased 5xxs, customers seeing responses from wrong model variant (v1.2 served when v1.4 requested), and repeated fallback loop between region and variant. Auto-triage: routing.policy=smart-fallback, kv-cache prefixing=by_region_only. Severity: SEV-2. Page sent to eng-oncall and eng-sre.

Alex (eng-oncall): On it. pulling logs now. any recent routing config changes?

Priya (eng-sre): I see a config rollout at 2026-03-15T09:03:12Z that removed model_id from KV cache key for prefixing (so we only keyed by region). That would explain model variant bleed between requests.

Marco (eng-runtime): Confirmed. routing-service commit 9f3a2b0 changed cache key to reduce cardinality (attempt to improve hit rate). It looks like when fallback to a different region occurs we end up reusing the KV cache which contains the previous model's KV cache entries -> wrong KV state -> wrong outputs.

Jen (ml-infra): That's bad. Model KV cache must be isolated by model_id+variant. If variant isn't included, different weights / kv shapes get mixed. We need immediate mitigation: prevent cross-variant reuse.

Alex (eng-oncall): Agreed. Suggested mitigs (short term): 1) disable smart-region-fallback for affected customers 2) purge kv cache prefixes for eu-west-1 3) temporarily set routing.policy=region-strict for all traffic to eu-west-1 -> fallback turned off. Which of these can we do safely?

Priya (eng-sre): I can flip routing.policy for eu-west-1 on the control plane. Doing stepwise: set region-strict and disable fallback. Will also add a routing rule to pin by model_id. Executing now.

deploy-bot: deploy started: control-plane-config@2026-03-15T09:28:03Z by priya.

Priya (eng-sre): Done. routing.policy updated -> region-strict, fallback disabled for eu-west-1. Can we purge cache next?

Marco (eng-runtime): We have an admin endpoint to evict prefix. Command: 

```
curl -X POST "https://admin.internal.redwood/v1/cache/evict" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"prefix":"kv:eu-west-1:", "confirm":true}'
```
I'll run a targeted purge to avoid full-cold start.

Marco (eng-runtime): Purge in progress. Running on routing nodes and kv-shards.

deploy-bot: cache-evict job queued: job-5821.

Marco (eng-runtime): Purge completed on primary kv-shards in eu-west-1. Verified evictions ~1.8M keys.

Alex (eng-oncall): Observability: 5xx rate is dropping but some customers still report wrong model outputs. Is there a stale shard or regional misroute?

Jen (ml-infra): Doing deeper KV checksum compare. I see mismatched namespace headers on a subset of requests: some clients are still routed to eu-central-1 due to stale smart-routing cache in the CDN edge. That would explain occasional matches. We need to invalidate edge caches.

Priya (eng-sre): Invalidating edge routing caches now (CDN + routing-agent caches). Command: 

```
POST /admin/edge/invalidate
{ "scope": "routing-cache", "regions": ["eu-west-1","eu-central-1"] }
```
Started.

Riley (support): Customer impact: hitting support triage — 3 customers reported incorrect model responses (two enterprise customers: AtlasChat and FinGrid). They reported garbled answers and hallucinations consistent with wrong variant behavior. Tickets opened: #CH-452, #CH-453, #CH-454. Notifying account teams.

Eve (product): We should prepare a customer-facing statement. Can someone confirm percentage of affected requests? Need numbers for status page.

Marco (eng-runtime): From sampling: roughly 0.9% of global requests in the last hour, but localized to eu-west-1 traffic it was up to 6.3% during the misconfiguration window. For enterprise customers routed through pinned variants it was ~2-5%.

Alex (eng-oncall): Good. I'll update status page with: "Partial degradation in eu-west-1 affecting a subset of requests; mitigation in progress; wrong model variant served for some requests."

Alex (eng-oncall): Next steps (short): 1) keep fallback disabled until we patch routing key logic 2) roll back commit 9f3a2b0 OR re-deploy with model_id included in cache key 3) full e2e smoke test for model pinning in eu-west-1 4) reach out to impacted customers with root cause and remediation plan.

Jen (ml-infra): I can prepare a patch that includes model_id+variant+region in the kv cache key and adds a defensive server-side check to reject cached entries that don't match model metadata. Pushing a hotfix now.

deploy-bot: deploy started: runtime-hotfix-include-modelid@2026-03-15T10:02:11Z by jen.

Marco (eng-runtime): Hotfix deployed to canary nodes in eu-west-1. Running validation on sampled requests.

Jen (ml-infra): Canary looks clean. No variant bleed observed on sampled flows. Promoting to rest of eu-west-1 now.

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: runtime-hotfix-include-modelid@2026-03-15T10:12:02Z.

Alex (eng-oncall): Monitoring: 5xxs back to baseline, wrong-variant errors down to ~0.02% of requests (noise). Turning smart-routing fallback back on is NOT safe until we fully QA. Leave fallback disabled.

Priya (eng-sre): Agreed. We'll keep region-strict for eu-west-1 and monitor for 24 hours. Also adding an audit check to prevent future change that removes model_id from cache key.

Riley (support): I pinged AtlasChat PM and FinGrid admin with a short note and temporary workaround (toggle to dedicated endpoint to avoid smart-routing). They appreciate quick response; asked for RCA.

Eve (product): We'll draft an incident summary for customers. Please include timeline, root cause (routing config removed model_id from kv key), mitigations (region-strict, cache purge, hotfix), and rollback plan if needed. Assign author?

Alex (eng-oncall): I'll own immediate incident report draft. Priya/Jen/Marco, please add technical details. Riley/Eve add customer impact notes. Will handoff to postmortem owner later.

Priya (eng-sre): Creating incident channel and pagerduty postmortem ticket.

incident-bot: Incident channel created: #inc-2026-03-15-smart-cache-variant-bleed. PagerDuty: PD-8912 assigned to oncall.

Alex (eng-oncall): Quick checklist before we close this page: - confirm no regressions in next 2 hours - update runbooks to include a test for cache key invariants - add config lint to PRs that touch routing.cache_key - schedule postmortem with ML infra and runtime teams.

Marco (eng-runtime): I'll add a runtime assertion: on cache read, verify model_id header matches cached metadata hash; if mismatch -> evict and fallback to cold load. That should mitigate similar issues even if config changes slip through.

Jen (ml-infra): Also scheduling a smoke test that verifies variant isolation across region fallbacks in our CI harness.

Riley (support): I'll follow up with the customers with ETA for RCA doc (~24-48 hours) and offer credits where appropriate.

Alex (eng-oncall): Thanks everyone. Marking this thread as resolved for the immediate pager. Follow-up tasks tracked in the incident channel.

Priya (eng-sre): closing oncall handoff at 10:59 UTC; handing to duty-ops for monitoring.

incident-bot: Pager resolved. Duration: 2h 16m. Severity: SEV-2. Root cause summary: routing config removed model binding from KV cache key -> cross-variant cache reuse when fallback triggered -> wrong model outputs. Mitigations: region-strict routing, cache eviction, edge invalidation, runtime hotfix reintroducing model_id in key + defensive checks. Postmortem assigned.
